Lemma
[Lower bound along the diagonal] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0380, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0381 ↗ cor:chow-iii-heat-kernel-local-mass-lower-bound 1. ch26:26.30\group Heat Kernel Lower Bounds

There exists $c>0$ such that \[ H(y,\tau ;y,v)\ge \frac{c}{\Vol _{\widetilde g}B_{\widetilde g}(y,\sqrt{\tau -v})}. \]
Proof

\sketch The Li–Yau Harnack inequality compares the diagonal value at time $\tau $ with values on a parabolic-scale ball at the midpoint time. Integrate that comparison and apply Corollary 2.

□
